# Native weighted finish with current editor defaults

Exact synthetic production API HTTP request/response bodies captured on
2026-10-30: native definition create 200, finish 200 and ordinary read 200.
The exercise matches the ordinary editor/repository defaults: chest, noncompound,
2.50 kg plate step, no starting weight, no optional prescription defaults and no
typed execution definition. The finished scalar set has 20.0 kg, 8 repetitions
and null observed RIR. Its original finish instant is explicit UTC, duration is
260 seconds and notes are omitted. No catalog/typed action is translated.

These bodies retain their actual captured bytes. Endpoint origins, headers,
credentials, private setup and owner data are excluded. Tests substitute only
UUID identities consistently, and compare the complete produced command against
the corresponding captured request. This host replay does not qualify a new APK,
phone, catalog mapping or additional login method.
